q: Ramu jailed 3 yrs no trial writes inland letter on no lawyer citing old poor-prisoner rulings. Principle?
expl: Letter for voiceless undertrial triggers PIL jurisdiction.
why: Epistolary help is for unable. It is not private standing.

q: Lawyer with no personal loss files on press freedom citing disclosure case. View?
expl: Public-spirited standing allowed for constitutional cause.
why: PIL allows bona fide citizen. Personal loss not needed.

q: Fresh law gives executive major say in judge picking citing reform. Petition cites 2015 verdict. Result?
options: Risks strike if harms independence; collegium holds
why: Appointment law tested on independence. Basic feature guards.

q: Vijayawada 10-day custody with no reasons; brother rushes to Amaravati alleging new-code breach. Best?
options: Wider HC writs can test remand
expl: High Court reaches legal-right remand safeguards.
why: Wider scope helps beyond FR-only. Remand needs reasons.

q: Auditor finds AP mineral funds unaccounted; Collector calls him removable clerk. Correct?
options: Wrong; judge-like tenure, reports to committee
why: Independence secures AP audit. Pleasure doctrine absent.

q: Why is President-seeking guidance not binding even by full bench?
expl: Advisory lacks lis; no decree enforceability.
why: Design splits adjudication and guidance. Binding needs contest.

q: Why give High Courts wider writ reach than top court despite rank?
options: Local access for legal wrongs; top for FR core
expl: Federal access plus FR centrality explains wider HC.
why: Citizens reach nearby HC. Top guards core.

q: Claim: HC writs ONLY for fundamental rights NEVER for others. Flaw?
options: False exclusion; HC reaches others too
expl: Only-never absolute false; HC wider by design.
why: Absolutes signal false extreme. Compare FR-only vs wider.

q: President seeks advice on lapsed 40-yr ordinance, no live case, storm. Govt ignores. Permissible?
expl: Advice guides without binding even in extreme politics.
why: Extreme facts keep nature. Persuasive not decree.

q: Link custody, funds, postcard: illegal hold, misuse, poor family letter. Combined view?
options: Habeas for custody, audit for funds, letter can trigger PIL
expl: Each lane protects liberty accountability together.
why: Institutions complement. No substitution across lanes.
